# isEqualInt64Array

> Test if two arguments are both Int64Arrays and have equal values.

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var isEqualInt64Array = require( '@stdlib/assert/is-equal-int64array' );
```

#### isEqualInt64Array( v1, v2 )

Tests if two arguments are both Int64Arrays and have equal values.

```javascript
var Int64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int64' );

var x = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2 ] );
var y = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2 ] );
var bool = isEqualInt64Array( x, y );
// returns true

bool = isEqualInt64Array( x, new Int64Array( [ 1, 3 ] ) );
// returns false
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="notes">

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var Int64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/int64' );
var Uint64Array = require( '@stdlib/array/uint64' );
var isEqualInt64Array = require( '@stdlib/assert/is-equal-int64array' );

var x = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2, 3 ] );
var y = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2, 3 ] );
var out = isEqualInt64Array( x, y );
// returns true

x = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2, 3 ] );
y = new Uint64Array( [ 1, 2, 3 ] );
out = isEqualInt64Array( x, y );
// returns false

x = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2, 3 ] );
y = new Int64Array( [ 1, 2, 4 ] );
out = isEqualInt64Array( x, y );
// returns false
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
